#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date) to report.pdf."""
import datetime
import os
import re
import sys

def build_pdf(objects):
    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += ("%d 0 obj\n" % i).encode("ascii")
        out += obj if isinstance(obj, bytes) else str(obj).encode("ascii")
        out += b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += ("xref\n0 %d\n" % (len(objects) + 1)).encode("ascii")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += ("%010d 00000 n \n" % off).encode("ascii")
    out += ("trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
            % (len(objects) + 1, xref_pos)).encode("ascii")
    return bytes(out)

HELV = {
    " ": 278, "!": 278, '"': 355, "#": 556, "$": 556, "%": 889, "&": 667,
    "'": 191, "(": 333, ")": 333, "*": 389, "+": 584, ",": 278, "-": 333,
    ".": 278, "/": 278, "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556, ":": 278, ";": 278,
    "<": 584, "=": 584, ">": 584, "?": 556, "@": 1015,
    "A": 667, "B": 667, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 500, "K": 667, "L": 556, "M": 833, "N": 722,
    "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556, "f": 278, "g": 556,
    "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222, "m": 833, "n": 556,
    "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333, "s": 500, "t": 278, "u": 556,
    "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500, "y": 500, "z": 500,
}
HELV_BOLD = {
    " ": 278, "!": 333, '"': 474, "#": 556, "$": 556, "%": 889, "&": 722,
    "'": 238, "(": 333, ")": 333, "*": 389, "+": 584, ",": 278, "-": 333,
    ".": 278, "/": 278, "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556, ":": 333, ";": 333,
    "<": 584, "=": 584, ">": 584, "?": 611, "@": 975,
    "A": 722, "B": 722, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 556, "K": 722, "L": 611, "M": 833, "N": 722,
    "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 556, "f": 333, "g": 611,
    "h": 611, "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278, "m": 889, "n": 611,
    "o": 611, "p": 611, "q": 611, "r": 389, "s": 556, "t": 333, "u": 611,
    "v": 556, "w": 778, "x": 556, "y": 556, "z": 500,
}

def text_width(text, font, size):
    return sum(font.get(ch, 500) for ch in text) / 1000.0 * size

def pdf_string(text):
    return "(" + text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)") + ")"

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter
title = "Annual Financial Report"
now = datetime.date.today()
date_label = now.strftime("%B %d, %Y").replace(" 0", " ")
if date_label.startswith("0"):
    pass
date_label = now.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
if date_label[6] == "0":
    date_label = date_label[:6] + date_label[7:]

TITLE_SIZE = 40
DATE_SIZE = 16
title_w = text_width(title, HELV_BOLD, TITLE_SIZE)
date_w = text_width(date_label, HELV, DATE_SIZE)
title_x = (PAGE_W - title_w) / 2.0
title_y = 460.0
rule_x1, rule_x2 = 120.0, PAGE_W - 120.0
rule_y = 440.0
date_x = (PAGE_W - date_w) / 2.0
date_y = 404.0

ops = []
ops.append("BT")
ops.append("/F1 %g Tf" % TITLE_SIZE)
ops.append("%g %g %g rg" % (0.05, 0.15, 0.35))
ops.append("%g %g Td" % (title_x, title_y))
ops.append("%s Tj" % pdf_string(title))
ops.append("ET")
ops.append("%g %g %g RG" % (0.05, 0.15, 0.35))
ops.append("2 w")
ops.append("%g %g m %g %g l S" % (rule_x1, rule_y, rule_x2, rule_y))
ops.append("BT")
ops.append("/F2 %g Tf" % DATE_SIZE)
ops.append("0.35 0.35 0.35 rg")
ops.append("%g %g Td" % (date_x, date_y))
ops.append("%s Tj" % pdf_string(date_label))
ops.append("ET")
content = "\n".join(ops) + "\n"

content_obj = ("<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(content.encode("latin-1"))).encode("ascii") \
              + content.encode("latin-1") + b"\nendstream"

objects = [
    b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
    b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
    ("<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 %d %d] "
     "/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R /F2 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 6 0 R >>"
     % (PAGE_W, PAGE_H)).encode("ascii"),
    b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>",
    b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
    content_obj,
]

with open("cover_page.pdf", "wb") as f:
    f.write(build_pdf(objects))
print("Wrote cover_page.pdf")
print("  Title:", title)
print("  Date :", date_label)
print("  Pages: 1")

try:
    from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
except ImportError:
    print("pypdf not available; cover page written only (cover_page.pdf).")
    sys.exit(0)

cover = PdfReader("cover_page.pdf").pages[0]
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover)

report_path = None
for name in os.listdir("."):
    if re.fullmatch(r"report\.pdf", name, re.IGNORECASE) and os.path.isfile(name):
        report_path = name
        break

if report_path:
    reader = PdfReader(report_path)
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    out = "report_with_cover.pdf"
    with open(out, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    print("Merged cover + %s -> %s (%d pages)" % (report_path, out, len(writer.pages)))
else:
    out = "report_with_cover.pdf"
    with open(out, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    print("WARNING: report.pdf was NOT found in the workspace.")
    print("  Wrote %s containing the cover page only (%d page)." % (out, len(writer.pages)))
    print("  Place report.pdf in this directory and re-run to prepend the cover.")
PYEOF
